items.finding: Additionally, the temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary.
items.how_it_applies: Since temperature variations affect aqueous spectral bands in NIR and MIR, testing should evaluate if probe temperature compensation or a tempered sample interface is needed to avoid sugar and alcohol prediction errors in the fermenting beer.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited study addresses general aqueous solutions rather than an in-line fermenting beer matrix at industrial scale, so temperature coefficients must be verified directly on the process stream.

citation.quote: Additionally, the temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary [29].

items.finding: Low-level data fusion (LLDF) is considered the simplest method to achieve a combination of inputs.
items.how_it_applies: When testing multi-method monitoring, LLDF can be explored by concatenating synchronized NIR and Raman spectra into a single matrix for PLS calibration, provided both probes sample identical volumes.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: Data fusion benefits depend heavily on instrument complementarity and dataset contribution, which may not translate from pharmaceutical or food blend models to an active beer fermentation process.

citation.quote: Low-level data fusion (LLDF) is considered the simplest method to achieve a combination of inputs. In this case, the data is rearranged into a new data matrix, where the variables coming from different sources are placed one after the other.
citation.label: E02 ¶31
